nodes.description: Constant state variable holding the OldTrueUSDInterface contract instance at 0x8dd5fbce2f6a956c3022ba3663759011dd51e73e
Constant state variable holding the NewTrueUSDInterface contract instance at 0x0000000000085d4780B73119b644AE5ecd22b376
Constant state variable holding the TokenControllerInterface contract instance at 0x0000000000075efbee23fe2de1bd0b7690883cc9
Constant address of the TrueUSD registry (0x0000000000013949f288172bd7e36837bddc7211)
Constant address used as the global pause (address(0))
Public upgrade() function that performs the full ownership/storage migration between old and new TrueUSD contracts, controller, and helper
External call tokenController.claimOwnership() that makes the UpgradeHelper the owner of the TokenController
External call newTrueUSD.claimOwnership() that makes the UpgradeHelper the owner of the new TrueUSD contract
External call newTrueUSD.setTotalSupply(oldTrueUSD.totalSupply()) initializing the new token supply from the old token
External calls oldTrueUSD.balances() and oldTrueUSD.allowances() returning the BalanceSheet and AllowanceSheet storage contract addresses
External calls tokenController.requestReclaimContract/issueClaimOwnership/transferChild that move storage child contracts and oldTrueUSD under the controller
External call newTrueUSD.transferOwnership(tokenController) transferring ownership of the new token to the controller
External call oldTrueUSD.delegateToNewContract(newTrueUSD) redirecting the old token delegation to the new token
External call tokenController.transferOwnership(endOwner) handing final controller ownership back to the captured end owner
Local variable storing the pending end owner read from tokenController.owner()
Local variable holding the BalanceSheet storage contract address read from oldTrueUSD.balances()
Local variable holding the AllowanceSheet storage contract address read from oldTrueUSD.allowances()

edges.reason: upgrade() reads the oldTrueUSD constant to call totalSupply(), balances() and allowances()
upgrade() reads the newTrueUSD constant to set supply, claim ownership and transfer ownership
upgrade() reads the tokenController constant to perform the whole migration sequence
upgrade() reads the registry constant when configuring the token controller
upgrade() reads the globalPause constant when configuring the token controller
upgrade() unconditionally invokes tokenController.claimOwnership()
upgrade() unconditionally invokes newTrueUSD.claimOwnership()
upgrade() unconditionally invokes newTrueUSD.setTotalSupply()
upgrade() unconditionally calls oldTrueUSD.balances()/allowances()
upgrade() unconditionally calls the controller reclaim/claim/transferChild sequence
upgrade() unconditionally calls newTrueUSD.transferOwnership(tokenController)
upgrade() unconditionally calls oldTrueUSD.delegateToNewContract(newTrueUSD)
upgrade() finally calls tokenController.transferOwnership(endOwner)
endOwner is assigned from tokenController.owner()
balanceSheetAddress is assigned from oldTrueUSD.balances()
allowanceSheetAddress is assigned from oldTrueUSD.allowances()
balanceSheetAddress flows into the controller reclaim/claim/transferChild calls
allowanceSheetAddress flows into the controller reclaim/claim/transferChild calls
endOwner flows into the final tokenController.transferOwnership call
tokenController.claimOwnership() is an external call back into an attacker-influenced contract while upgrade() state is mid-migration
tokenController child-transfer calls are external and could re-enter upgrade() during the ownership migration
oldTrueUSD.delegateToNewContract() is an external delegation call that can re-enter before ownership handover completes

normalization_plan.reason: endOwner is only an intermediate holder of tokenController.owner() that is immediately consumed by the final transferOwnership call, so it can be normalized into that unsafe operation
balanceSheetAddress is derived from oldTrueUSD.balances() and used only as an argument to the controller storage-child operations, so it can be merged into that unsafe operation
allowanceSheetAddress is derived from oldTrueUSD.allowances() and used only as an argument to the controller storage-child operations, so it can be merged into that unsafe operation
